definitions.explanation: The act of starting or founding a business. Also refers to the time when a business was first established.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は1920{年|ねん}に{創業|そうぎょう}した。
{創業|そうぎょう}100{年|ねん}を{迎|むか}えた{老舗|しにせ}の{旅館|りょかん}だ。
examples.english: It is a long-established inn that has reached its 100th anniversary since founding.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{小|ちい}さな{町工場|まちこうば}を{創業|そうぎょう}し、やがて{全国|ぜんこく}に{知|し}られる{企業|きぎょう}に{育|そだ}てた。
examples.english: My father founded a small town factory and eventually grew it into a nationally known company.

notes:
Commonly seen on company websites and in business contexts. Japanese companies often proudly display their founding year, especially long-established ones. Distinguished from {設立|せつりつ} (establishment), which often refers to the legal incorporation date, while 創業 refers to when business operations actually began.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{創業|そうぎょう}{者|しゃ}: founder
・{創業|そうぎょう}100{年|ねん}: 100 years since founding
・{創業|そうぎょう}{以来|いらい}: since the founding
